turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my coffee maker started leaking again. Any tips before I buy a new one?
Oh no, that's annoying. Try checking if the gasket is seated properly or if the water reservoir is overfilled. Sometimes descaling helps too if mineral buildup is forcing leaks.
I'll check the gasket. Anyway, I've been reading up on ORCA for the new navigation module. It's surprisingly efficient.
Oh, ORCA is quite popular for multi-agent path planning. What specifically are you finding interesting about it?
The scalability. It seems like it linearizes RVO constraints and operates in O(n) per agent via 2D linear programs.
Yes, that's a key advantage over traditional sampling methods. The linear programming approach keeps the computational load manageable even with many agents.
Exactly. Also, did you see the weather forecast for next week? Looks like rain.
Yes, I saw that. It might be wise to keep an umbrella handy if you're walking to the office.
